description: S.A.S. Karunawathie Epa v. G. Francis Direckze S.A.S. Karunawathie Epa v. G. Francis Direckze View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: S.A.S. Karunawathie Epa v. G. Francis Direckze S.A.S. Karunawathie Epa v. G. Francis Direckze View More
keywords: Appellant sought to set aside the District Court judgement entered on three promissory notes under Chapter 53 of the Civil Procedure Code; however, Appellant was absent and unrepresented at the hearing, and had not given evidence in the District Court nor led expert evidence to prove that two promissory notes were fraudulently executed. The Plaintiff-Respondent had given evidence without Objection. Held - silence in response to the Letter of Demand amounted to an admission of the allegations therein; no particular form of words is essential to the validity of a promissory note but the form must manifest the intention to make a note; Appeal dismissed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Civil Procedure Code
